question: What honour did ISRO chief V. Narayanan receive in Kolkata in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rammohan Mission Purashkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rammohan Mission Purashkar** is a prestigious award given to individuals or organizations for their outstanding contributions in various fields, including science, technology, literature, and social service.
 
• In the year **2025**, **V. Narayanan**, the renowned chief of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**, was honored with the Rammohan Mission Purashkar for his exceptional contributions to India's space research and technological advancements.
 
• **V. Narayanan** has played a pivotal role in strengthening ISRO’s capabilities, particularly in the areas of **cryogenic technology** and the development of advanced propulsion systems, which are critical for satellite launches and space exploration missions.
 
• This award highlights the efforts of Indian scientists in ensuring India’s global recognition in the field of **aerospace engineering** and **space exploration**.
 
• The award is named after **Raja Rammohan Roy**, a prominent social reformer of India, symbolizing the spirit of innovation and progress in the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **V. Narayanan's Contributions to ISRO:**

 
 
• He is a distinguished scientist and the director of the **Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC)**, a key facility of ISRO responsible for the design and development of liquid propulsion systems.
 
• Under his leadership, India successfully developed the **Cryogenic Upper Stage (CUS)** used in the GSLV Mk-II launch vehicle, marking a significant milestone in India's space program.
 
• He has been instrumental in advancing **semi-cryogenic propulsion technology**, which is critical for heavy-lift launch vehicles.
 
 
 
• **Rammohan Mission Purashkar:**
 
 
• This award is conferred annually to individuals who have made remarkable contributions to their respective fields, promoting the ideals of innovation and excellence.
 
• It aims to encourage and recognize efforts that contribute to the nation’s development and global standing.
 
 
 
• **ISRO’s Achievements in Recent Years:**
 
 
• ISRO has successfully launched several ambitious missions, including **Chandrayaan-2** and **Mangalyaan**, showcasing India’s capabilities in interplanetary exploration.
 
• The organization is currently working on the **Gaganyaan mission**, India’s first human spaceflight program, which is expected to be a landmark achievement.
 
• ISRO's launch vehicles, such as the **PSLV** and **GSLV**, have established India as a reliable player in the global satellite launch market.
 
 
 
• **Raja Rammohan Roy:**
 
 
• Known as the **Father of the Indian Renaissance**, Raja Rammohan Roy was a social reformer who played a key role in the abolition of practices like **Sati** and championed women's rights, education, and modern values.
 
• The award named after him symbolizes the fusion of traditional Indian values with modern scientific and technological advancements.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Prestigious Indian Awards:**

 
 
• **Bharat Ratna:** India’s highest civilian award, conferred for exceptional service in arts, literature, science, and public services.
 
• **Padma Awards:** Includes **Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan**, and **Padma Vibhushan**, given for contributions across various fields like arts, science, and social work.
 
• **National E-Governance Award:** Recognizes excellence in the implementation of e-Governance initiatives in the public sector.
 
 
 
• **India’s Space Ambitions:**
 
 
• India is striving to establish itself as a global leader in space exploration, with plans to develop **reusable launch vehicles**, **space stations**, and missions to the **Moon** and **Mars**.
 
• ISRO has been collaborating with other space agencies like **NASA**, **ESA**, and **Roscosmos** to share technologies and expertise.
